long_biography.plain_text:
Komárek entered business after the Velvet Revolution, beginning with an industrial-equipment company in his home town of Hodonín. Work supplying the mining sector led into oil and gas, and the family group acquired Moravské naftové doly. A 2010 division of family assets left him with the energy and financial businesses that became the base for his independent KKCG portfolio.

His decisive diversification came through the acquisition and rebuilding of Czech lottery operator Sazka. Komárek grouped the expanding lottery interests as Sazka Group, later renamed Allwyn, and added businesses across Europe and North America. The platform's combination with OPAP in 2026 created the world's second-largest listed lottery and gaming operator, with KKCG remaining its strategic shareholder.
